⌈
If
the
Global Supervision Status
was
GLOBAL_STATUS_STOPPED and the Local Supervision Status of at least
one Supervised Entity Instance is LOCAL_STATUS_EXPIRED, then the
Platform Health Management shall keep the Global Supervision Status
GLOBAL_STATUS_STOPPED.
⌋

[SWS_PHM_00232] Keep Global Supervision Status kSTOPPED
⌈
If the
Global Supervision Status is kSTOPPED, the Elementary Supervision
Status of at least one Alive, Deadline or Logical Supervision is kEXPIRED and
the GlobalSupervision corresponds to Operating System, Execution Management
or State Management, then the Platform Health Management shall keep the
Global Supervision Status kSTOPPED.
⌋
